clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Bangalore Advaitha
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of Bangalore Advaitha is a group of young people who come together to serve the community, learn new things, build connections, and have fun along the way. We conduct social service activities, professional development sessions, fellowship events, and other initiatives that help us grow as individuals while making a positive difference around us.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Bangalore East
clubs.description: RBE is a space where fun fellowship service self development and networking come together to create experiences that truly matter. Through our various avenues we provide opportunities for members to lead collaborate learn and build connections that last beyond Rotaract 🌍🧡

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Bangalore High Grounds
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of Bangalore High Grounds is a vibrant community of young individuals united by the spirit of service, leadership, fellowship, and friendship. The club provides a platform for members to discover their potential, take initiative, build meaningful connections, and contribute to society through impactful projects. From community service and professional development to fellowship and creative initiatives, the club encourages every member to learn, lead, and grow. High Grounds believes that Rotaract is more than just an organisation—it is a family where people come together, support one another, create lasting memories, and work towards making a meaningful difference in the community.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Bangalore Institute of Technology
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of Bangalore Institute of Technology is a youth-led service organization committed to creating a positive impact through community service, professional development, leadership, and fellowship. The club brings together passionate students who work collaboratively to address community needs, develop meaningful initiatives, and build leadership skills. Through service projects, awareness campaigns, skill-building activities, and engaging events, the club strives to empower young individuals and contribute to society. With a strong focus on teamwork, innovation, and responsible leadership, the club aims to inspire its members to become proactive changemakers and create sustainable impact in the community.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Bangalore Jayanagar
clubs.description:
Built on a legacy of 49 years of service, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore Jayanagar is a passionate community of young individuals dedicated to serving society, fostering leadership, and creating lasting impact.
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore Jayanagar is a vibrant community of young leaders committed to service, growth, and creating meaningful impact. Chartered under Rotary International, we work to bring about positive change through initiatives spanning education, healthcare, environmental sustainability, youth development, and community welfare.

Guided by the support of Rotary Bangalore South and driven by the passion of our members, we foster a culture of fellowship, leadership, and service. We believe in empowering individuals to make a difference—not only within their communities but also in their own personal and professional journeys. United by a shared vision, we continue to build on our legacy of service while inspiring lasting change for generations to come.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar
clubs.description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar is a youth-led service organisation under Rotary International, operating within Rotary International District 3191. We undertake structured community initiatives across healthcare, education, environmental conservation, community welfare and youth development.

During Rotary Year 2025–26, our club completed 82 projects, contributed 5,610 volunteer hours and positively impacted 1,955 beneficiaries. Our strength lies in identifying genuine community needs and translating partner support into responsibly executed and well-documented initiatives.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of BMSCE
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of BMSCE, chartered on 1st March 2014, is committed to empowering communities and creating meaningful social impact. Our flagship projects focus on key areas such as fighting diseases, promoting basic education and literacy, and addressing community needs. This year, we aim to strengthen our contribution to the foundation, undertake impactful joint initiatives with Interact Clubs and organize RYLAs to develop leadership and interpersonal skills among young individuals. Through meaningful collaborations and engaging initiatives, our goal is to create a lasting and positive impact through every event we undertake, while fostering a culture of service, leadership and community development.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of DA Pandu RV Dental College
clubs.meeting_location: DA pandu rv Dental College mini auditorium
clubs.description: The Rotaract Club of DAPM RV Dental College is a vibrant, student-led organization dedicated to community service, leadership development, and professional growth. Bridging healthcare advocacy with social welfare, the club empowers future dental professionals to drive meaningful change. Through oral hygiene awareness drives, blood donation camps, skill-building workshops, and collaborative youth initiatives, members foster strong fellowship and ethical leadership. Guided by Rotary’s core value of "Service Above Self," the club strives to bring smiles beyond clinical walls and nurture compassionate healthcare leaders committed to uplifting society.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Govt. Engg. College Ramanagara
clubs.description: The Rotaract Club of Government Engineering College – Ramanagara is a club comprising of Rotaractors  who are students pursuing engineering, who believe in learning by doing and serving with purpose. From community service and awareness initiatives to professional development and fellowship, the club creates opportunities for Rotaractors to explore, connect and grow. It is a space where friendships are built, ideas are shared, talents are discovered and leadership is developed along the way.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Indian Institute of Fashion Technology
clubs.description: Rotaract is a youth-led institution service club that brings together young people to serve, connect, and create positive change. It encourages members to develop leadership skills, build meaningful friendships, and contribute to society through social, cultural, and service activities. Rotaract is a place where young minds come together to make a difference while learning, growing, and having fun.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Koramangala
clubs.description:
The Rotaract Club of Koramangala is a dynamic youth-led organization based in Bengaluru, functioning under Rotary International District 3191. The club brings together passionate young leaders committed to creating meaningful impact through community service, professional development, and fellowship.

Known for its innovative and high-impact projects, the club actively works across areas like education, sustainability, healthcare, and social awareness. With a strong focus on collaboration and leadership, it empowers its members to grow while making a difference in society.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Krupanidhi Group of Institutions
clubs.description: The Rotaract Club of Krupanidhi Group of Institutions (KGI) is a youth-led organization dedicated to service, leadership, fellowship, and professional development. We bring together passionate students who strive to make a positive difference in society through meaningful initiatives and collaborative efforts. Our activities focus on health, education, environmental sustainability, social welfare, youth empowerment, and community development. Through awareness campaigns, service projects, skill-building programs, and fellowship activities, we encourage members to develop leadership qualities, build lasting relationships, and become responsible citizens. Guided by the spirit of "Create Lasting Change,” we aim to empower youth and create a better, more compassionate community.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of KSSEM
clubs.meeting_location: K. S. School of Engineering and Management
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of KSSEM is a vibrant community of young leaders driven by the passion to create meaningful impact. We bring together passionate students to make a difference through community service, professional development, leadership initiatives, international collaborations, cultural exchanges, and networking opportunities. From empowering communities to connecting with young leaders across borders, we turn ideas into action and friendships into lifelong connections. We learn, lead, serve, and grow together, building a generation of responsible and confident changemakers ready to make a difference.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Mount Carmel (Deemed to be University)
clubs.meeting_location: Mount Carmel(Deemed to be University) 's VC room
clubs.description: The Rotaract Club of Mount Carmel (Deemed to be University) stands as one of the largest and most dynamic clubs in District 3191. A thriving community of young leaders, it champions service, fellowship, and professional growth through impactful projects that address real community needs. With a strong membership base and an active spirit of collaboration, the club creates opportunities for students to lead, innovate, and give back. Guided by Rotary International's motto of "Service Above Self," the club continues to set benchmarks in community service, leadership development, and youth engagement across the district.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Narsee Monjee Institute of Mangement Studies, Bangalore
clubs.description:
Rotaract Club of NMIMS

The Rotaract Club of NMIMS is a community of young, driven individuals committed to creating a positive impact. Through social service, fundraising, awareness campaigns, professional development, and engaging events, the club encourages students to step beyond themselves and contribute to society. It provides a platform to develop leadership, teamwork, communication, and organizational skills while building meaningful connections. More than just a club, Rotaract is a space where ideas turn into action, friendships grow, and every member gets an opportunity to make a difference.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of RNS Institute of Technology
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of RNSIT is a dynamic student-led community dedicated to creating positive change through community service, leadership, professional development, and fellowship. As part of the Rotaract movement, the club provides students with a platform to identify social needs, develop meaningful initiatives, and actively contribute to society. The club organizes activities focused on areas such as education, healthcare, environmental sustainability, menstrual hygiene, blood donation, awareness campaigns, and community development. Alongside service, Rotaract encourages members to develop essential leadership, communication, teamwork, event-management, and networking skills through various projects and district-level engagements. The club believes in the principle of “Service Above Self” and strives to transform ideas into impactful action. Through collaboration with other Rotaract clubs, NGOs, organizations, and community partners, the Rotaract Club of RNSIT aims to build responsible young leaders and create sustainable, measurable social impact.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of SEI College Tejas
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of SEI College Tejas is a youth-led community service club focused on promoting sustainable lifestyles, eco-friendly practices, and environmental responsibility. Through innovative initiatives and awareness projects, we strive to inspire young minds to make greener choices and create a positive impact on our planet.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Seshadripuram Institute of Commerce & Management
clubs.meeting_location: College Auditorium - Seshadripuram Institute Of Commerce & Management
clubs.description: We are a vibrant community of young leaders driven by the spirit of service, friendship, and positive change. Through impactful projects, meaningful collaborations, and fun-filled fellowship, we empower our members to grow, lead, and make a difference. From community service and social initiatives to professional development and networking, our club creates opportunities to learn, connect, and contribute. Together, we believe in turning ideas into action and making every effort count.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College KGF
clubs.meeting_location: Sri Bhagwan Mahaveer Jain College KGF
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College is a student-led community service organization dedicated to developing leadership, teamwork, and social responsibility among young people. The club encourages students to actively participate in community service projects, awareness campaigns, skill development activities, and social initiatives while creating a positive impact on society.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of SRNGS Boys Hostel
clubs.meeting_location: S R N G Sampannappa Boys Hostel
clubs.description: The Rotaract Club of SRNGS Boys Hostel is a vibrant community of young leaders committed to creating meaningful impact through service, leadership, fellowship, and personal growth. Based at SRNG Sampannappa Boys Hostel, Bengaluru, the club actively organizes community service initiatives, professional development programs, cultural celebrations, leadership activities, and fellowship events that empower members while serving society. Guided by the values of Rotary, the club strives to inspire positive change, nurture future leaders, and build lifelong connections through impactful projects and collaborative action.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of S.S.M.R.V. College
clubs.description: Rotaract Club of SSMRV College is a youth-led service organisation committed to creating meaningful impact through community service, professional development, leadership, and fellowship. Chartered in 2009 and sponsored by Rotary Club of Bangalore Cantonment, the club brings together passionate young minds to learn, lead, and serve. Under Team Vistara 2026–27, we strive to “Lead Beyond Limits” by empowering members, fostering innovation, building collaborations, and turning ideas into impactful initiatives for society.

clubs.club_name: Rotaract Club of S-VYASA
clubs.meeting_location: S vyasa deemed to be university global city P3 building
clubs.description: The Rotaract Club of S-VYASA Deemed to be University is a dynamic student-led organization committed to service, leadership, professional development, and community engagement. The club provides students with opportunities to develop their leadership skills while contributing meaningfully to society through various social, educational, health, and environmental initiatives. As part of Rotary International District 3191, the club actively participates in district events, collaborative projects, awareness campaigns, and community service activities. Through teamwork, volunteering, and innovative events, the club aims to create responsible leaders, strengthen student connections, and make a positive and lasting impact on both the university and the wider community.
